claims: Monitor electrolyte levels, particularly potassium, closely.
Administer IV potassium if potassium levels remain low.
Monitor blood pressure closely and adjust medications as necessary.
Continue IV fluids to maintain adequate hydration.
Assess for potential sources of hyperkalemia or hypokalemia, such as medication review.
Monitor for signs of anxiety or agitation and consider sedation if needed.
Perform a head-to-toe assessment to evaluate for any new skin breakdown or pressure ulcers.
Monitor vital signs and ensure adequate oxygenation.
Continue to monitor for signs of myocardial injury with repeat creatine kinase levels if indicated.
Assess the patient for potential causes of the elevated heart rate and blood pressure.
